description: Register a webhook publishing target: MotiBlog POSTs the published article JSON to your endpoint (signed with X-Signature: sha256=<HMAC(secret)> when secret is set). Config shape: { url, secret?, method? }. This is how an agent's own infrastructure receives content pushes. Setup and endpoint behavior: https://motiblog.ai/mcp.

project_id.description: MotiBlog project id permitted by the current credential. Omit when a default project is configured.

secret.description: HMAC secret used to sign deliveries

url.description: HTTPS endpoint receiving the article payload
